programmes.d: Featuring PBC ERM at the Loxahatchee Slough, the river center in Jupiter, Delaware Scrub Urban Natural Area and the art of nature segment with Lawrence Leyderman.

programmes.t: Sportsman's Adventures With Captain Rick Murphy
programmes.d: Capts. Rick and Ridge Murphy target snook in their backyard in the Florida Everglades.
John Bergsma showcases fishing hot spots in the Great Lakes region.
Jimmy and Roland Bass fishing in Florida.
Avery Wall carries on the family tradition in Kansas and proves patience can turn into a hunt to remember.
This week, we are looking back at some of our best western hunts from over the years!

Watch the 1 hour Bass Fishing Action on the BAM Pro Tour Bass Tournament on Oroville Thermalito Afterbay! Experience the excitement of the Bass Boat Technologies BAM Pro Tour as top anglers take on the unique challenges of Thermalito Afterbay!

Renowned angler Meredith McCord and Capt. Justin Leake continue their quest for a line class world record; when struggles begin the moment they leave the dock, grit and lady luck ensure an epic day ends in grand style.
In Ecuador, communities work to balance agriculture, sustainability, and conservation in one of the most ecologically diverse regions in the world.
Features include the Florida ASL Festival, Pickleball for All at the CMAA Therapeutic Recreation Complex, Phoenix Boxing Gym, the Jupiter Riverwalk, and The Therapeutic Alternative.

Mark Peterson heads to the rugged terrain of California in pursuit of Roosevelt elk with a rifle and a muzzleloader. Known as one of the premier destinations for giant Roosevelt elk, Mark will be armed with his brand-new Gunwerks Magnus MZ5...
Features include charging system diagnosis, how to keep rodents out of your vehicles, and more on Motorhead Garage, TV's only automotive aftermarket showcase.
Patrice and Kevin McCabe camp at Cook Forest State Park in northwest Pennsylvania. Later, they go on a Forest Cathedral hike, and visit Elk Country.

After hosting Sydnie Wells for an incredible Texas hunting experience, Max gets the chance of a lifetime - hunting Illinois whitetails during the rut with Sydnie and her father, the renowned Tim Wells.
Opening weekend of dove season is finally here, and the Three Curl crew is kicking it off with clients, plenty of birds, and a morning they've been waiting on all year.
Justin Martin takes his first trip to Heaven in Locust Grove with Ira McCauley, Beau Brooks and Brook Richard. Beautiful greenheads do it right on this episode!
Pursuit UP Presents: The Luke Branquinho Show.
Chappy continues his pursuit of Wyoming bobcats and coyotes, relying on his expertise with traps and snares as he battles cold winds and deep snow at elevations between 4,000 and 6,000 feet.
From behind-the-scenes insight with the testers who develop Yamaha Side-by-Sides and ATVs, to professional racers.

The Slock Master reveals the tricks and tips that fool predators. Bowhunting coyotes, fox, lion, bobcat and more with incredible close-up call-ins and amazing archery action. Watch the world's top bowhunter slock em on The Slock Master.

Adam returns to Ohio with renewed determination after his Illinois success, setting his sights on a massive 10-point buck that's eluded him twice during the rut. Every moment counts as he pursues what could be the second giant of his dream season.

The wind dies down on day two, creating ideal fishing conditions & perfect atmosphere for our veterans to open up about their experiences. Through heartfelt conversations & improved catches, these heroes demonstrate the healing power of camaraderie.
Feeding Programs for Attracting Wildlife.

programmes.t: The High Road With Keith Warren
programmes.d: Keith Warren is joined by Mark Peeples, a gentleman with a voice like no other who does the VO work for The High Road. Mark is joined by his family as they hunt for management deer at Keith Warren's famous ranch in Oklahoma known as The Refuge!
Blaine heads to Texas after what might be his worst season ever hunting whitetail deer. Can Texas deliver?

The best whitetail deer hunting stories from across the nation; incorporating product features, up-close encounters, storytelling, insight about management, as well as tactics to both entertain and educate even the most seasoned whitetail hunter.
Kyle Egerdeee makes his first trip to Saskatchewan to hunt with Canadian Whitetail Outfitters.

Saskatchewan's reputation for producing massive whitetails draws Kenny and his son Tucker north for an epic hunting adventure. Tucker faces the ultimate test on his first Canadian hunt as they target the province's legendary giant bucks.

Noah's Saskatchewan adventure begins with an exciting waterfowl hunt before he turns his attention to pursuing a mature whitetail buck. Over the next five days, he stays patient and focused, putting in long hours as the hunt unfolds.
Tony and Brett Byer spend New Years in Texas hunting whitetails and hogs.

programmes.t: The Bassquatch Hunter Fish Out of Water
programmes.d: Mike McKinstry heads to see our good friends at the Detroit Zoo for another fun adventure! This time Mike meets with Mark Vassallo from the NACC (National Amphibian Conservation Center) and learns about the important conservation work.

Ralph returns to Kansas and rejoins JandM Whitetails for another opportunity at a mature whitetail with his bow. With fresh determination after a short break to run to Illinois, he's back and ready to stick a Kansas Whitetail stud!
Blaine's luck has not changed in Texas. He swings for the fences trying to get his first buck down.

Kenny faces one of his biggest challenges yet as he navigates Colorado's unforgiving mountain terrain on the final day of his elk hunt. With two consecutive archery elk tags already filled, he's determined to make it happen for a third success.
After two years with the Canadian border closed due to the pandemic, host Gus finally makes it back to Alberta Bush Adventures in the Peace River boreal forest - but not without a fight.

Capt. Justin Leake attempts to blend in with the crowd aboard a local head boat; he finds friends, talented deckhands and a heck of a good time; how industrial trash is being used to create artificial reef treasures.
Features include the Boating & Beach Bash for People With Disabilities, Busch Wildlife Sanctuary, Wheel the World, and the Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse Sensory Day.
Retired Boxer King Pedford joins Larysa Switlyk in Hungary for his first European hunt after roe deer and seeing what hunting in Europe is all about.
Host Wade Middleton and friends search for adventures in the outdoors.
Patrice and Kevin McCabe show off outtakes and extra footage, including the new Winnebago unveiling and bonus footage from Branson, Missouri.

This episode takes the crew to Lake Fork in Texas. Known for its great bass fishing, Mark and Xavier will be looking to catch some giant crappie. Mark met Xavier at the Crappie Classic through a mutual relationship they hold with Jenko Fishing.

Brett takes Heli-Hunter pilot Cody out for his first thermal hog hunt to see if he's as good on the ground as he is in the air. Then Charles, Brett and the Three Curl crew head to a dove-loaded water hole for an afternoon of fast shooting.
Justin Martin takes his first trip to Heaven in Locust Grove with Ira McCauley, Beau Brooks and Brook Richard. Beautiful greenheads do it right on this episode!
The final episode in this three-part Wyoming trapping classic follows Chappy as he continues thinning out coyotes to help the rancher achieve better calving success come spring.

Junior and Jeff venture into the rugged wilderness of New Brunswick in pursuit of elusive black bears, while Blaine sets his sights on trophy whitetail deer in the heartland. Three different hunts, one shared passion for the outdoors.
Join us this week as Shawn and crew travel to West Texas for some fabulous Crane & Pheasant hunting !
Hank's grandsons, Boone and Cade, head to New York for some Smallie action… while Hank gets behind the camera to help them create their own show. This could be interesting!
Jimmy and Mr Crappie fishing in Texas.
